lesson: The short position failed because the market absorbed overhead supply at 1580, indicating a potential Wyckoff Spring or accumulation phase rather than a continuation of the bearish structure. The system incorrectly prioritized macro bearish bias over the immediate failure of sellers to defend key resistance levels.
adjustment: Require a confirmed break of market structure (BOS) on the 15-minute timeframe before entering shorts, rather than relying solely on macro-level overhead supply.
methodology_flag: Trust Wyckoff accumulation patterns more than macro bearish structure when price fails to reject key resistance.
